name: AKEL bill: annual 0.1% tax on immovable property above 3 million euro (tabled December 2025)
detail: Property-only levy (0.1% a year on the combined immovable property of a person or company above 3 million euro, collected through the Land Registry), no debts deducted and no other assets; the second bill is a registration levy on companies by asset size. Presented by MP Aristos Damianou, rejected in the plenary of 22 December 2025 with the votes of DISY and DIKO (party outlet). Re-read in R002 from the committee report and the Finance Ministry replies: neither bill touches financial assets, so both stay out. The House texts at parliament.cy block scripts.

name: Stefanos Stefanou (AKEL General Secretary)
detail: Presented the AKEL property and company-levy bills and says the reform serves wealth; no statement found that calls for a tax on net wealth itself.

name: Christos Christofides and Giorgos Loukaides (AKEL MPs)
detail: Spoke for redistribution of wealth in the December 2025 debate; the page does not show them calling for a tax on wealth.

name: DISY and DIKO
detail: Opposed AKEL's property and company bills in the December 2025 reform debate.

name: 2013 deposit haircut and special defence contribution
detail: Not wealth taxes (one-off bank bail-in; income-based levy).

name: Stavros Papadouris (Greens MP) and the Cyprus Greens
detail: Asked in committee to drop the first home from AKEL's property levy and scale it, and to combine it with a tax on dormant property: a property tax, not a wealth tax.

name: Cyprus Property Owners Association (KSIA) chairman Giorgos Mouskidis
detail: Opposed AKEL's property levy, saying that if the state taxes wealth it should tax all assets, not property only; not support.
